code: facts <- list(   northern = c(revenue = "Revenue was 45.2 million dollars.", units = "Leeds made 12,400 units."),   southern = c(revenue = "Revenue was 51.8 million dollars.", staff = "There were 310 staff."),   eastern  = c(revenue = "Revenue was 38.9 million dollars."),   western  = c(revenue = "Revenue was 29.4 million dollars.", exports = "Exports rose 7 percent."))  cl <- gr_mock_client(function(messages, params) {   seen <- paste(vapply(messages, function(m) as.character(m$content), ""), collapse = " ")   region <- regmatches(seen, regexpr("(northern|southern|eastern|western)", seen))   asked <- sub(".*Question", "", seen)   topic <- c("revenue", "units", "staff", "exports")   hit <- topic[vapply(topic, grepl, logical(1), x = asked, ignore.case = TRUE)][1]   reply <- facts[[region]][hit]   if (is.na(reply)) return("NOT_IN_DOCUMENT")   if (identical(params$model, "mock-small") && runif(1) < 0.3) return("The report is unclear.")   reply })  bench <- hr_benchmark(arms, qa, runs = 5, client = cl, scorer = gr_scorer_answer()) bench #> <hr_bench> 2 arm(s) x 8 item(s) in 4 cluster(s) x 5 run(s); split test; scorer answer_contains #>  arm   accuracy runs wrong failed budget_stop usd    #>  small 0.750    40   10    0      0           0.0013 #>  large 1.000    40    0    0      0           0.0132 #>   Descriptive only: accuracy is the mean over runs within each item, then over labelled items, with no interval. head(bench[, c("item", "arm", "run", "correct", "failure_kind", "usd", "draw_index")]) #>    item   arm run correct failure_kind      usd draw_index #> 1 n_rev small   1   FALSE        wrong 3.10e-05          1 #> 2 n_rev small   2    TRUE         <NA> 3.42e-05          2 #> 3 n_rev small   3    TRUE         <NA> 3.42e-05          3 #> 4 n_rev small   4    TRUE         <NA> 3.42e-05          4 #> 5 n_rev small   5   FALSE        wrong 3.10e-05          5 #> 6 n_rev large   1    TRUE         <NA> 3.42e-04          1

Three can set every reader: cited_unknown, chunk ids answer cited never sent; unverified_evidence, number quoted spans chunk claim come ; unread_pages, pages never became text. makes answer partial. warnings Character. harnessr warned document ingested, cut read, named warning's class. warnings still print happen; copy stays answer, including document came ingestion cache nothing raised . evidence Data frame NULL, columns chunk_id, text, page, section, score, kind. text holds depends reader: verbatim chunk text stuff, retrieve, rerank iterative; model-extracted passages skim; per-chunk model answers map_reduce. refine hierarchical return NULL. page populated PDF sources; score retrieve (cosine) rerank (0-10, model-judged). evidence model-written (skim), three columns appear: source_text, chunk span claims quote, plus verified match checking one ; see gr_verify_evidence().
